reason: A DeepSeek Harness side-panel plugin combining local directory browsing, read-only Git status and history visualization, injected-context inspection, file dragging into chat, and session-log download.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加集成目录浏览、只读 Git 状态与提交图、上下文文档查看及会话日志下载的侧边面板。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness side panel for directory browsing, read-only Git status and history views, injected-context inspection, file dragging into chat, and session-log downloads.

capabilities: Reads local directory entries and bounded file contents through plugin routes
Invokes read-only local Git operations for repository status, history, and diffs
Displays injected context documents and session history in a browser panel
Downloads session logs and accepts dragged file paths for chat use
